# Readable text on the top bar and the Record card, fix/contrast169 (Minecraft 1.21.11, 1280x720, GUI scale 3 = 426x240;
# the demo song, paused on "Every word is written in the stars" with "the stars" on the highlight, so the shots hold still).
# Run it on the branch, and with -f mod_ref=main for the old code (the script then comes from the branch):
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/contrast169 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/contrast169.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/contrast169 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/contrast169.txt
# Each picture is taken three times: in front of a snow wall at noon (the brightest the world gets: "-snow"), looking up
# at the noon sky ("-sky"), and shut in a stone box (a dark place: "-dark").
#
# What to look for (old code / branch):
# 1. contrast-*-default: the default look. The clock left of the bar and the FPS right of it: on main they have no
#    shadow and the clock all but vanishes on the snow wall (about 1.1:1) and is faint on the sky (2.1:1), the grey FPS
#    is faint on both. Branch: both have the game's text shadow (a dark edge down and right of each letter) and read on
#    snow and sky; in the box they look as before. The bar itself, the violet highlight and its white words: the same.
# 2. contrast-*-yellow: Accent colour picked Yellow. Main: "the stars" white on a bright yellow highlight, barely
#    readable (1.2:1). Branch: the highlight is a deeper mustard of the same yellow and the white words read (3:1);
#    the equaliser and the progress line stay bright yellow on both.
# 3. contrast-*-lyrics: Accent colour Lyrics, the lyrics' periwinkle. Main: white on pale periwinkle (1.45:1). Branch:
#    a deeper greyish blue under the words. contrast-*-white: Accent picked White: main white on white (1.05:1), branch
#    mid grey.
# 4. contrast-*-card: the Record card bottom left with Card lines at 3 (the line before and after the current one).
#    Main: those two small lines are faded nearly into the card (2:1). Branch: they read, a little dimmer than the
#    artist's name. The current line, the title, the artist and the times: the same on both.
# 5. contrast-*-card-blue: the lyrics colour a deep blue (2626FF). Main: the card's current line dark blue on the dark
#    card (2:1, hard to read). Branch: a lighter blue that reads; the lyrics in the sky stay deep blue on both.
# 6. contrast-snow-pixel: 1 with Minecraft's own letters (Font: Minecraft): the clock's and FPS's shadow is the same
#    one the game puts under its own words.

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
guiscale 3
sleep 8
music pause
sleep 1
seek 27.6
sleep 2
where

# A snow floor and a snow wall in front, lit by the noon sun
cmd execute as @p at @p run fill ~-24 ~-1 ~-24 ~24 ~-1 ~24 minecraft:snow_block
cmd execute as @p at @p run fill ~-24 ~ ~8 ~24 ~34 ~8 minecraft:snow_block
look 0 -10
sleep 4
shot contrast-snow-default
set barAccentColor 16769126
sleep 1
shot contrast-snow-yellow
set barAccentColor 16777215
sleep 1
shot contrast-snow-white
set barAccent LYRICS
sleep 1
shot contrast-snow-lyrics
set barAccent FIXED
set barAccentColor 9596126
set recordCard true
set cardLyrics true
set cardLines 3
set cardCorner BOTTOM_LEFT
sleep 2
shot contrast-snow-card
set colorMode FIXED
set color 2500351
sleep 4
shot contrast-snow-card-blue
set color 13095156
set recordCard false
set smoothFont false
sleep 4
shot contrast-snow-pixel
set smoothFont true
sleep 1

# The noon sky
look 0 -60
sleep 3
shot contrast-sky-default
set barAccentColor 16769126
sleep 1
shot contrast-sky-yellow
set barAccentColor 16777215
sleep 1
shot contrast-sky-white
set barAccent LYRICS
sleep 1
shot contrast-sky-lyrics
set barAccent FIXED
set barAccentColor 9596126
set recordCard true
sleep 2
shot contrast-sky-card
set color 2500351
sleep 4
shot contrast-sky-card-blue
set color 13095156
set recordCard false
sleep 4

# Shut in a stone box: a dark place
cmd execute as @p at @p run fill ~-4 ~-1 ~-4 ~4 ~5 ~4 minecraft:stone hollow
look 0 -10
sleep 4
shot contrast-dark-default
set barAccentColor 16769126
sleep 1
shot contrast-dark-yellow
set barAccentColor 16777215
sleep 1
shot contrast-dark-white
set barAccent LYRICS
sleep 1
shot contrast-dark-lyrics
set barAccent FIXED
set barAccentColor 9596126
set recordCard true
sleep 2
shot contrast-dark-card
set color 2500351
sleep 4
shot contrast-dark-card-blue
set color 13095156
set recordCard false
set cardLines 1
sleep 1
